reader.requirement: At --std 85 a relative file's minimum and maximum record sizes are fixed when it is created (OPEN OUTPUT, or I-O/EXTEND creation of an optional file) and no later OPEN through a description of other sizes, fixed or RECORD VARYING, changes them; under GR8's latitude WiseOwl validates them, so such an OPEN is unsuccessful (39) and leaves the file as it was.
reader.edition-search: grep of FixedFileAttributes.cs, KeyedConnector.FixedAttributeConflict and the OpenOnceEntered '39' arm for Edition|DialectBehavior|SharingFacilityInEffect: none; KeyCheck is an environment switch, not an edition.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf25_02 and 1985-GR-VIII_4_4_4-18 cover fixed-length sizes only; RECORD IS VARYING bounds and the RECORD CONTAINS integer-4 TO integer-5 form are not exercised

probes.printed: QV CREATE 2-12 00 / QV WRITE 5 00 / QV WRITE 12 00 / QV WRITE 13 44 / QW I-O 2-20 39 / QM INPUT 4-12 39 / QT INPUT CONTAINS 2 TO 12 00 / QV INPUT 2-12 00 / QV READ 00 05 03ABC / QV READ 00 12 100123456789 / QV END 10
probes.expected: sizes 2..12 established at creation; a 13-byte WRITE 44 (VIII.1.3.4 5)d.1); descriptions 2..20 and 4..12 are refused 39 and change nothing; the matching 2..12 forms open 00 and the records read back unchanged
a file created by an optional I-O OPEN keeps that description's size

reader.notes: The keyed store's meta page records the creation's record type and min/max sizes and FixedFileAttributes.Conflicts compares them before OpenCore runs, so the file is never touched by the refused OPEN; the validated set is the documented DOC-A.1-129 determination under GR8's implementor latitude.

refuter.evidence: Probe runs/r18_implicit-001: a file created OUTPUT through 'RECORD IS VARYING IN SIZE DEPENDING ON' with records X(2) and X(12) (bounds implied by the RECORD clause GR6/GR7) then opened INPUT through VARYING FROM 2 TO 12 gives 00 and reads 02 AB / 12 ABCDEFGHIJKL / 10. The implied sizes were established at creation. EXTEND through a fixed RECORD CONTAINS 12 description gives 39 and random I-O through 3-12 gives 39, and neither changes the file. runs/r15_outrecreate-001: a later OUTPUT re-creation establishes the new sizes (4-byte description then 39). Validating record sizes and answering 39 is within GR8's implementor latitude. cite.py: OK  §1985:VIII.4.4.4 GR18  (4.4.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR18; OK  §1985:VIII.4.4.4 GR8  (4.4.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR8
